'''FK Bežanija''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|ФК Бежанија}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Bežanija]], [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]]. They compete in the [[Belgrade Zone League]], the fourth tier of the [[Serbian football league system|national league system]]."}}
